- **#33** `/now` page doctrine — tied into the rot-check as the most present-tense-heavy page in the site

- **#35** Case-study presentation mode — reuses View Transitions, corrects the bare-keyboard-trigger mistake up front
- **#36** Inline zoom-to-detail — native `<dialog>`, distinct from the lightbox gallery pattern
- **#37** Activity rhythm visualization — named and avoided the literal GitHub-heatmap reflex
- **#38** Micro-case-study format — compressed two-beat shape, no dedicated URL
- **#39** Booking calendar — self-hosted Cal.com over embedded Calendly, per §9
- **#40** Per-load generative seed — the bigger creative swing, with CLS/determinism/verification tradeoffs stated explicitly
